verdict.rationale: MoonPay exposes server-side API endpoints for quotes and session tokens, OpenAPI-based client codegen, webhooks for event-driven automation, and a test mode/sandbox with simulated payments and testnets, all of which can be scripted in CI. However, the 'headless' payments still mount hosted frames in a browser UI, and key steps (MFA login, card capture, challenge/KYC frames) need interactive customer UI, so fully unattended end-to-end runs are not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless automation guidance, non-interactive transaction execution without hosted frames, an accessible OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
